en.flavor: A reliable steel sword. The legendary Skyrider once tried to ride it as a flying sword... for the second time.

refinements.1: On hit, Normal or Charged Attacks increase ATK by <r>6%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can occur once every 0.5s.
refinements.2: On hit, Normal or Charged Attacks increase ATK by <r>7%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can occur once every 0.5s.
refinements.3: On hit, Normal or Charged Attacks increase ATK by <r>8%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can occur once every 0.5s.
refinements.4: On hit, Normal or Charged Attacks increase ATK by <r>9%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can occur once every 0.5s.
refinements.5: On hit, Normal or Charged Attacks increase ATK by <r>10%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can occur once every 0.5s.

fr.flavor: Une grande épée fiable. On raconte que quelqu'un a essayé de s'en servir comme moyen de transport en montant dessus... pour la deuxième fois.

refinements.1: Les attaques normales et chargées augmentent l'ATQ de <r>6 %</r> pendant 6 s lorsqu'elles touchent. Cet effet peut être cumulé 4 fois maximum et déclenché une fois toutes les 0,5 s.
